messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Heads-up: HelixEdge SI saw node panics when our private image binds the i40e driver during kubelet startup. Customer wants go-live Sat 04:00 UTC. They asked for an urgent delivery mitigation plan.
Oscar (SI PM): Reproduced in their staging. Node halts with call trace referencing i40e_tx. They won't allow kernel change.
Tara (Field Eng): Paste from staging node:
``
[ 4321.123456] i40e 0000:03:00.0: i40e_tx: invalid skb, dropping
[ 4321.123460] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
```
Maya (Partnerships): Image used: rdw-private:2026-03-21-sha:9f7c2d. Firmware on NICs: v2.0.1. Nina (HW Partner) any insights?
Nina (HW Partner): v2.0.1 has a corner-case with large TSO frames on certain firmwares. We have v2.0.2 that limits descriptor coalescing; can fast-track to SI but needs approval.
Kunal (SRE): Short-term we can: 1) build initramfs patch to pin i40e to safe mode or blacklist; 2) add a console traffic-split to route traffic to hosted-fallback; 3) provide a field runbook for manual driver bind/unbind.
Tara (Field Eng): Customer policy allows initramfs hotpatches during maintenance windows. I'll try a staging hotpatch to mask i40e and boot 5 nodes. ETA 70m.
console-bot: Console: created ticket RDW-4988 (HelixEdge SI delivery) and route rule template helixedge.* -> traffic-split ready.
Maya (Partnerships): Need a recommended approach for SI sign-off by 01:30 UTC. If hotpatch fails, plan B is 100% hosted-fallback for initial cutover, then firmware rollout.
Oscar (SI PM): I'll ask customer for canary approval. Tara please drop staging result here.
Tara (Field Eng): Will do. Also adding runbook snippet to ticket: steps to upload hotfix, update-initramfs, reboot, verify kernel logs, and Console rollback flow.
